name: Obergurgl-Hochgurgl

source.note: Piste reference data — confirm at source. Approximate Obergurgl village; Hochgurgl is a separate linked base a few km away
Official gurgl.com ski-area information: 'From 1800 to 3030 meters above sea level'; '112 kilometers of slopes'. Vertical derived. Replaces the earlier 1,793–3,080 m skiresort.info figures.

Search summaries: 112.2 km of slopes plus 4.5 km of ski routes; 25 lifts including 11 gondolas and 7 chairlifts. skiresort (https://www.skiresort.com/en/ski-resort/gurgl-obergurgl-hochgurgl/ski-lifts/) lists 6 T-bars and a total capacity of 45,661 persons/hour. 24 of 25 lifts are typed.
Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Ski schools and rental shops operate at the bases

character: A high-altitude ski area at the top of the Ötztal with two linked sectors, Obergurgl (village at about 1,900 m) and Hochgurgl, reaching about 3,080 m at the Wurmkogl. It is one of Austria's most snow-sure areas, and passes of three days or more include the wider Ötztal Superskipass.
learning: Reference note: both Obergurgl and Hochgurgl have ski schools and gentle nursery slopes; confirm beginner areas and lesson products.
